# Pilot execution checklist — no participants enrolled

- [ ] Assign a facilitator; arrange actual educator review of held-out content and benchmark interpretations.
- [ ] Confirm adult volunteers with beginner familiarity, basic legal-move knowledge and ability to consent; exclude prior exposure to chosen held-out boards. Provide rules orientation separately if needed and record it.
- [ ] Prepare 5–8 anonymous codes and separate consent records; explain withdrawal, local storage, optional exports, sharing and retention/deletion arrangements.
- [ ] Check a fresh profile, build/content/engine versions, approved device/network, functioning exports and selected unexposed baseline/post/follow-up boards.
- [ ] Confirm Getting Started is acceptable; record any participant/facilitator difficulty change and its reason.
- [ ] Run baseline without help or immediate correctness feedback; record uncertainty/exposure.
- [ ] Observe the guided lesson; separately record independent practice, hints, facilitator help and foreground timing.
- [ ] Observe an untimed game and focused recovery; distinguish original decisions from familiar retries and engine reveals.
- [ ] Run a genuinely unfamiliar post-test with one unassisted response per board; do not substitute a repeated diagnostic or benchmark board.
- [ ] Export local evaluation and source-specific records with consent; inspect for unintended identifiers before sharing.
- [ ] Collect usability/clarity/difficulty feedback separately from performance measures.
- [ ] Schedule an actual 2–3 day follow-up with unused boards and no clock simulation; record missing follow-ups honestly.
- [ ] Summarize observed barriers, uncertainty and denominators; make no efficacy, Elo or 10× claim from this small formative sample.
